policy.secondReset: At least 3 claimable INT, 15-minute run and no active analysis; same controller policy for both node orders.
policy.absence: One advanceTo call per actual absence, departure cap applied once. Paid boundary receipts captured before bounded telemetry eviction.
policy.scope: Twelve deterministic profiles: eight return profiles and four two-hour active contrasts, two seeds and two paid node priorities. No grants, passive taps, automatic claims, infinite queue replenishment or month-scale campaign. Return times are sampled session observations, not exact offline unlock times.
